import sys
from collections import deque

mazeA = [['']*20 for _ in range(20)]
mazeB = [['']*20 for _ in range(20)]
q = deque()
distA = [[10000]*20 for _ in range(20)]
distB = [[[[10000 for _ in range(20)] for _ in range(20)] for _ in range(20)] for _ in range(20)]
dx = [-1, 1, 0, 0]
dy = [0, 0, -1, 1]

class Edge:
    def __init__(self, u, v, flow, capacity, next_edge):
        self.u = u
        self.v = v
        self.flow = flow
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.next = next_edge

e = []
head = [0]*505
p = [0]*505
v = [0]*505
dep = [0]*505

s = 501
t = 502
totalFlow = 0
n = 0
m = 0
cnt = 0

def addEdge(u, v, w):
    global cnt
    cnt += 1
    e.append(Edge(u, v, 0, w, head[u]))
    head[u] = cnt
    cnt += 1
    e.append(Edge(v, u, 0, 0, head[v]))
    head[v] = cnt

def bfs():
    for i in range(t+1):
        v[i] = 0
        dep[i] = 0
    q2 = deque()
    q2.append(s)
    v[s] = 1
    dep[s] = 1
    while q2:
        x = q2.popleft()
        i = head[x]
        while i != 0:
            edge = e[i-1]
            if not v[edge.v] and edge.flow < edge.capacity:
                p[edge.v] = i
                q2.append(edge.v)
                v[edge.v] = 1
                dep[edge.v] = dep[x] + 1
                if edge.v == t:
                    return True
            i = edge.next
        i += 1
    return False

def dfs(x, flow):
    if x == t or flow == 0:
        return flow
    tFlow = flow
    i = head[x]
    while i != 0:
        edge = e[i-1]
        if edge.capacity > edge.flow and dep[edge.v] == dep[x] + 1:
            delta = dfs(edge.v, min(tFlow, edge.capacity - edge.flow))
            if delta == 0:
                dep[edge.v] = 0
            e[i-1].flow += delta
            e[((i-1)^1)].flow -= delta
            tFlow -= delta
            if tFlow == 0:
                break
        i = edge.next
        i += 1
    return flow - tFlow

def runDinic():
    global totalFlow
    while bfs():
        totalFlow += dfs(s, 1000000007)

def main():
    global n, m, totalFlow, cnt
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    t = int(input_data[1])
    index = 2
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            distA[i][j] = 10000
            mazeA[i][j] = input_data[index]
            index += 1
            if mazeA[i][j] == 'Z':
                q.append((i, j))
                distA[i][j] = 0
            if mazeA[i][j] <= '9':
                addEdge(s, (i-1)*n + j, int(mazeA[i][j]))
    while q:
        x, y = q.popleft()
        for i in range(4):
            nx = x + dx[i]
            ny = y + dy[i]
            if 0 < nx <= n and 0 < ny <= n and mazeA[nx][ny] <= '9' and distA[nx][ny] > distA[x][y] + 1:
                distA[nx][ny] = distA[x][y] + 1
                q.append((nx, ny))
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            if mazeA[i][j] > '9':
                continue
            for k in range(1, n+1):
                for l in range(1, n+1):
                    distB[i][j][k][l] = 10000
            q.append((i, j))
            distB[i][j][i][j] = 0
            while q:
                x, y = q.popleft()
                for f in range(4):
                    nx = x + dx[f]
                    ny = y + dy[f]
                    if 0 < nx <= n and 0 < ny <= n and mazeA[nx][ny] <= '9' and distB[i][j][nx][ny] > distB[i][j][x][y] + 1 and distA[x][y] < distA[nx][ny]:
                        distB[i][j][nx][ny] = distB[i][j][x][y] + 1
                        q.append((nx, ny))
            for k in range(1, n+1):
                for l in range(1, n+1):
                    if distB[i][j][k][l] <= min(distA[k][l], t):
                        addEdge((i-1)*n + j, (k-1)*n + l + 100, 10000)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            mazeB[i][j] = input_data[index]
            index += 1
            if mazeB[i][j] <= '9':
                addEdge((i-1)*n + j + 100, t, int(mazeB[i][j]))
    runDinic()
    print(totalFlow)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
